sentences.text: This is first application under Section 482 of BNSS for grant of anticipatory bail.

The applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.18/2018 registered by Police Station - Shahjahanabad, District Bhopal (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.
It is argued by the counsel for applicant that the applicant has appeared as a witness in the present case and his deposition before the trial Court was recorded on 01.02.2019.
He was a witness in the matter and now he has been made accused in matter and authorities are taking all possible steps for arresting him.
He is ready to co-operate in the investigation to be carried out by the police authorities.

He has always co-operated in the investigation as he appeared before the authorities as and when called for and also got NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:22032 2 MCRC-17587-2025 recorded his deposition, which is reflected from the document filed alongwith the application for taking documents on record.
Counsel appearing for the State on 30.04.2025 was directed to seek instructions with respect to recording of statement of applicant in the year 2019.
Again on 02.05.2025 he was directed to comply with earlier order.

Today, he has placed before this Court an order-sheet of the trial Court dated 08.05.2025 pointing out the fact that an application has been filed before the trial Court by the Mohd.Athar Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158246525/

sentences.text: prosecution not to take consideration the statement of the applicant recorded on 01.02.2019 as he is one of the accused in the matter.
The fact remains that the applicant has co-operated with the authorities since the year 2019 and has never misused the liberty granted to him.

Considering the fact that the applicant is the first offender and has co- operated in the investigation with the authorities, subject to verification of the fact that the applicant is the first offender, this Court deems it appropriate to allow this anticipatory bail application.

In the event of arrest, applicant Mohd. Athar Ali is directed to be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Arresting Officer.
The applicant is directed to mark his presence before the concerning Police Station in first week of every month till the conclusion of investigation and is directed to cooperate in investigation.

This order will remain operative subject to compliance of following conditions by the applicant :-
1.
The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:22032 3 MCRC-17587-2025 the bond executed by his;

2. The applicant will cooperate in the investigation/trial, as the case may be;
3.

sentences.text: Now, an application has been filed on 08.05.2025 before the trial Court not to consider the aforesaid deposition at the time of arguments and in the pending trial.
Applicant was named in the FIR.

The charge-sheet discloses the fact that the applicant is absconding in the matter, then how the applicant has been shown as a witness in the matter when his deposition was recorded on 01.02.2019 is a matter to be enquired into.
How the prosecution has produced the applicant before the trial Court for recording his deposition?
The deposition-sheet dated 01.02.2019 shows that it pertains to S.T. No.1044/2018.

The present case, wherein the offence has been registered is S.T.
No.1044/2018.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:22032 4 MCRC-17587-2025

Under these circumstances, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the Superintendent of Police, Bhopal to look into the matter and conduct a detailed enquiry with respect to the fact that how the prosecution agency/enquiry officer has produced the applicant as a witness before the trial Court and got his deposition recorded and to find out the person, who has committed the mistake either the enquiry officer or the public prosecutor.
Let the enquiry report be placed before this Court for perusal within 30 days.
